rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a 3AB blastocyst and correctly identifies stronger ICM and looser TE, but the image quality limits confidence and some specifics such as blastocoel occupying 60–70%, central ICM position, and detailed TE distribution appear somewhat over-interpreted.

Integrates age, BMI, prior failed cycle, male factor, endometrial thickness, ovarian response, and lifestyle factors with embryo quality in a clinically meaningful way, though a few links are somewhat speculative.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with a plausible probability estimate derived from embryo grade and patient modifiers; minor issues include overemphasis on stress effects and assumptions about sole embryo availability.

Much of the assessment is broadly aligned with IVF practice, but recommendations such as ERA after a single failed cycle, immune/NK testing, thrombophilia screening, and routine PGT-A suggestion in low-yield cases are not strongly guideline-supported.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer support, metabolic/nutritional optimization, and future workup, though some suggested investigations are more controversial than standard.
